pinout.assumes: which lead is pin 1: the drawing carries no pin numbers, so 1=G 2=D 3=S rests on the JEDEC convention that numbering runs left to right with the tab away from the viewer
pinout.shows: SOT-223 Top View: the tab is D, and the three leads are S, D, G in order along one side
